hook.name: QuiverHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for the Quiver launchpad on Robinhood Chain. In afterSwap, skims a per-token tax (0–10%, fixed at launch) from every trade via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accrued fees can be harvested permissionlessly and are split 50/25/25 among token holders (as purchased stock rewards), the pool creator (as claimable WETH), and the protocol treasury.
